rows.label: The fixture is served and rendered by Default Admin
The requested conditions are in effect (dark class / forced colours / reduced motion / high contrast class)
form--checkbox-toggle.css is requested by the page
The automatic switch rule is present in a loaded stylesheet
Checkboxes on the fixture that are wider than they are tall (switch shape)
A standalone checkbox has the box of a checkbox in a group
The switch thumb (::before) is drawn on a standalone checkbox
No stylesheet request fails, and none is missing
Failed requests and console errors during the run
JavaScript errors
Type, role, checked, disabled, required, indeterminate, label and description of every probed checkbox are the same
No checkbox carries a role attribute; no role="switch" on the page
The browser accessibility snapshot of the form is the same
The indeterminate example is exposed as indeterminate
Tab reaches the first standalone checkbox
Tab reaches every enabled checkbox and no disabled one, in the same order
Space changes the focused checkbox, and changes it back
The focused checkbox has a focus indicator (outline or box shadow), unchecked / checked
The focused checkbox is in the viewport and nothing covers its centre
A change that is not saved is gone after a reload
A real click on the label checks the checkbox
Disabled checkboxes do not change on a real click (label of the unchecked one / the checked one itself)
Activating a checkbox does not submit the form or navigate
Save configuration keeps the value, and it is still set after a reload
Reset puts the saved value back (the site is left as it was found)
Both validation-error examples are marked invalid (error class and aria-invalid)
#states: the dependents are hidden, disabled and unchecked, then shown, enabled and checked
The checkbox replaced by AJAX has the box of a checkbox in a group
Checkboxes in a dialog have the box of a checkbox in a group
Checkboxes in a group, in a table and the select-all box have the same computed presentation
Radio buttons have the same computed presentation
Label text contrast of the enabled checkboxes is at least 4.5:1 (lowest; default standalone; in a group)
Contrast of the control edge against the background around it, unchecked / checked (WCAG 1.4.11 asks for 3:1); a group checkbox for reference
An invalid checkbox looks different from a valid one (border, fill or shadow), unchecked / checked
The indeterminate example looks different from an unchecked one
No label overlaps its control, including the long label
The control lines up with the first line of its label (centre offset, default / long label)
Right to left: the page is rtl, the control is at the right of its label and the long label does not overlap it
The page does not scroll horizontally (left to right / right to left)
Standalone checkbox size; smallest centre-to-centre distance to another control (WCAG 2.5.8 asks for 24 by 24, or 24 of spacing)
Transition on the control or its thumb
Stylesheet payload of the page: requests, decoded bytes, bytes on the wire
axe findings on the fixture (rule: element) are the same or fewer
axe rules with findings while the validation errors show
